reviews.decision_reason: The assigned output preserves provenance fields for the two selected records: record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank are present and match the corresponding selected needs. No provenance mismatch is visible in the supplied semantic package.

The selection chose n06-r07 and n06-r08 even though the corpus contains stronger, directly relevant demand records for execution-branch isolation, exact artifact handoffs, bounded inspection, verified frontier resume, localization, and evidence comparison. The selected top need has lower demand_score/source_weight than multiple available alternatives, so the downstream recommendation prioritizes an unsupported lower-demand item. Under the strict market-demand criteria, this is a behaviorally significant demand-selection fault rather than sufficient evidence of customer demand.

The selected need records are normalized consistently into the assigned output and stdout: need_count and evidence_source_count are both 2, and the serialized stdout matches the structured assigned output. No normalization defect is visible in this package.
